about.title: Craftsmanship & Heritage
about.description1: Founded in 2003, Leather Legacy is a comprehensive enterprise specializing in high-end leather research, production, and sales. We possess advanced tanning processes and a strict quality management system, with products covering cowhide, sheepskin, specialty leather, and more.
about.description2: For two decades, we have adhered to the business philosophy of 'Quality First, Integrity Supreme' and established long-term stable partnerships with numerous renowned leather goods brands worldwide.
